name: build-design-contract-coverage
description: The build path's design-contract coverage gate (0g.1) and its reciprocal (10.2). The design brief names PanelHeader and SegmentedControl for both new screens, and both already exist under src/components/. The brief's Scope leaves and Exit Criteria are purely behavioural, so a screen with a hand-rolled header and its own row of window buttons passes every Exit Criterion. Build must map the named components onto the Scope rows and instantiate them; reusing the shared theme, or building a lookalike, is not reuse.
